text: How many countries other than DRC or Uganda will report at least one laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo case linked to this outbreak by 31 December 2026? (Baseline is 1 - France)
resolution_criteria: The number of countries other than DRC or Uganda with at least one laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo case linked to this outbreak, as of 31 December 2026. Baseline 1 (France). Source: WHO Disease Outbreak News.
